import novamind_api as nm
# Wk55 actual = d372-378: day%30 in {12..18}; churn end_day in (371,378]
BDM = "(12,13,14,15,16,17,18)"
E0, E1 = 371, 378
A49_PRE, A79_PRE, C_PRE = 1547, 348, 9871  # from wk54 forecast slice k=1 (start<330)
print("== WK55 (d372-378) BILLING FLOWS, old core start<330, A split <60/>=60 ==")
res = {}
# A split by effective price
for lbl, cond in [('A49', "plan='A' AND effective_price<60"), ('A79', "plan='A' AND effective_price>=60"), ('C', "plan='C'")]:
    st = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day<330 AND {cond} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    ch = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>{E0} AND end_day<={E1} AND start_day<330 AND {cond} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    res[lbl] = (st, ch)
    print(f"  {lbl}: now-subscribed={st} churned-in-window={ch}")
stA49, chA49 = res['A49']; stA79, chA79 = res['A79']; stC, chC = res['C']
A_PRE = A49_PRE + A79_PRE
stA = stA49 + stA79; chA = chA49 + chA79
dg_in  = stA - (A_PRE - chA)
dg_out = C_PRE - stC - chC
print(f"  A49: pre={A49_PRE} churn={chA49} ({chA49/A49_PRE*100:.2f}%)")
print(f"  A79: pre={A79_PRE} churn={chA79} ({chA79/A79_PRE*100:.2f}%) [dg_in joins here: {dg_in}]")
print(f"  C: pre={C_PRE} churn={chC} ({chC/C_PRE*100:.2f}%) dg_out={dg_out} ({dg_out/C_PRE*100:.2f}%)")
print(f"  consistency: dg_in({dg_in}) vs dg_out({dg_out}) vs dash 80")

# transient cohorts: 1st-bill this week = start in [342,349)
for lo,hi,lbl in [(342,349,'1stbill-this-wk'),(349,356,'1stbill-next-wk'),(356,378,'later-trickle')]:
    r = nm.query(f"""SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
      WHERE start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} GROUP BY status""")
    d = {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']}
    print(f"  cohort[{lo},{hi}) {lbl}: {d}")

# total churn decomposition this week
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>{E0} AND end_day<={E1}")['rows'][0]['n']
r_old = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>{E0} AND end_day<={E1} AND start_day<330")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"\nTotal cancels this wk: {r} (old-core {r_old}, tail {r-r_old}) vs dash 2193")

# old-core churn by plan/price bucket (ALL windows, to see if off-window churn exists)
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT plan, CASE WHEN effective_price<60 THEN 'lo' ELSE 'hi' END pb, COUNT(*) n
  FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>{E0} AND end_day<={E1} AND start_day<330
  GROUP BY plan, pb""")
print("old-core cancels by plan/price:", [(row['plan'],row['pb'],row['n']) for row in r['rows']])

# New subs this week by group/plan
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) p FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.start_day>={E0+1} AND s.start_day<={E1} AND s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC""")
print("\nNew subs (status=subscribed) d372-378 by group/plan:")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['g']} {row['plan']}: n={row['n']} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f}")
    tot += row['n']
print(f"  total={tot} vs dash 359")

# daily new subs to see decay curve
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT start_day d, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
  WHERE start_day>{E0} AND start_day<={E1} AND status='subscribed' GROUP BY start_day ORDER BY d""")
print("daily new subs:", [(row['d'],row['n']) for row in r['rows']])

# Book snapshot + durable split (start<330)
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})
r = nm.query("""SELECT plan, CASE WHEN effective_price<60 THEN 'lo' ELSE 'hi' END pb, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot
  FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<330 GROUP BY plan, pb""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  durable<330 plan {row['plan']}/{row['pb']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day>=330")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"  tail (start>=330): {r}")
